note: Host backends share the Java API 35 framework and C/C++ NDK layers, while translating OS primitives, graphics, media, services, isolation, and app packaging natively per operating system. Experimental ports do not imply full end-to-end app parity with Linux.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.summary: Standalone ART, host-ABI and optional Digitalis ARM64 native execution, 15/15 NDK libraries, SDL2/EGL/GLES, Vulkan ANativeWindow swapchain/AHB bridge, Landlock app isolation, WebRTC browser streaming, and per-app AppImages.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.summary: Standalone ART, guest ELF/Bionic loader, 15/15 NDK libraries, VideoToolbox H.264/HEVC/VP9/AV1 & AudioToolbox Opus, ProMotion display pacing, zero-copy IOSurface-to-Metal bridge, Security.framework trust, AVFoundation speech, CoreLocation, UNUserNotificationCenter, Seatbelt sandbox, SwiftUI Launcher, and signed Shiraz.app bundles.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.summary: Native Win32 shared memory, WaitForMultipleObjects looper, Named Pipe IPC, DXGI GPU & shared buffer pool, Win32 sync fences, DwmFlush choreographer, WASAPI audio, Media Foundation decoder probe, DirectWrite fonts, Shell_NotifyIconW, Windows Location COM, IFileOpenDialog/WinHTTP/CryptoAPI/SAPI services, Job Object + Restricted Token sandbox, and portable/MSIX bundler. Full ART + guest ELF execution on Windows is still in progress.

layers.linux: Standalone ART, host ELF + Bionic bridge, optional Digitalis ARM64 on x86_64, 15/15 API 35 NDK libraries (887/887 symbols).
layers.macos: Standalone ART, guest ARM64 ELF/Bionic loader, 15/15 API 35 NDK libraries, unified 16 KB page-size & ABI policy.
layers.windows: Unified HostOs / ABI / page-size policy, CreateProcessW process spawning, and MSVC build rules (mk/windows.mk); Win32 ART & guest ELF runtime integration in progress.

layers.linux: SDL2 windows (Wayland & X11, GTK-free), EGL/GLES, libvulkan.so with VK_KHR_android_surface swapchain & AHardwareBuffer memory bridge, Shiraz Web WebRTC streaming.
layers.macos: SDL2 / Cocoa windows, ANGLE/GLES, zero-copy IOSurface-to-Metal MTLTexture bridge, ProMotion CoreGraphics display refresh pacing, live resize watch, trackpad pinch & touch filter.
layers.windows: SDL2 / Win32 windows, DXGI adapter probe & shared RGBA buffer pool, Win32 sync fences, DwmFlush choreographer pacing, WM_SIZE/WM_SIZING live resize, Precision Touchpad hooks.

layers.linux: ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire audio, OpenSLES & AAudio, MediaCodec / libmediandk software and host codecs.
layers.macos: AudioToolbox / CoreAudio PCM, WAV, AAC & Opus; VideoToolbox H.264, HEVC, VP9 & AV1 decode; video recording unsupported.
layers.windows: WASAPI PCM16 playback & capture bridge; Media Foundation H.264, HEVC, VP9 & AV1 hardware decoder probe.

layers.linux: POSIX memfd/ashmem, epoll ALooper, Unix sockets, Linux Landlock LSM filesystem isolation + PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS + optional --no-internet seccomp policy.
layers.macos: POSIX/Mach shared memory, kqueue ALooper, Unix sockets, App Nap guard, macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) SBPL profile & App Sandbox bundle entitlements.
layers.windows: CreateFileMappingW shared memory, WaitForMultipleObjects looper, Named Pipe IPC with peer PID lookup, SetThreadExecutionState, Job Object + Restricted Token sandbox.

layers.linux: XDG directories, Fontconfig, desktop notification, file picker, connectivity & URL/file launcher hooks.
layers.macos: ~/Library paths, CoreText fonts, Security.framework trust anchors, AVFoundation speech voices, UNUserNotificationCenter, CoreLocation, NSWorkspace launcher.
layers.windows: LOCALAPPDATA / APPDATA paths, DirectWrite fonts, CryptoAPI trust store, SAPI speech, IFileOpenDialog picker, WinHTTP connectivity, Shell_NotifyIconW, Windows Location COM, ShellExecuteW.

layers.linux: Browser & CLI per-app AppImage builder, .deb packages, Linux x86_64 & ARM64 CI releases.
layers.macos: Signed Shiraz.app bundle builder (hardened runtime, allow-jit, optional --sandbox entitlements, @rpath closure, .icns), SwiftUI Launcher, macOS ARM64 CI.
layers.windows: Portable Shiraz\ & MSIX AppxManifest.xml bundler (PE32/PE32+ import resolver, .ico generator), Windows x64 MSVC CI.
